study: Binomial, normal approximation, multiplicity and cross-period Ganzhi randomness
scope: Research and repository delivery only; no production changes or trading optimization
threshold_rule: inclusive exact integer 100*k >= threshold*n, n includes flat observations
flat_rule: Keep flat observations in displayed denominators and fix their dates under every null; binary binomial trials m=n-flat, down=m-up
iid_actual: One constant p=full-sample up/(up+down) per return basis; treated as a fixed plug-in reference, not an exact composite-null test of an unknown fitted parameter
conditional_exact: Per-group hypergeometric conditional on period pooled up total; conditional maximum via finite polynomial convolution
normal: Approximate the same discrete probability-order two-sided binomial rejection set, both without and with half-integer continuity correction; no replacement of exact tests
joint: Select the majority direction using train only, then freeze it; both stages >= same fixed threshold; ties yield no signal
selection_ties: Descending exact rational training majority rate then ascending canonical Ganzhi index; never use validation to break ties
fixed_total: Independently permute nonflat signs/return bundles within each disjoint stage, preserving exact stage and therefore full up/down/flat totals
year_weekday: Permute nonflat bundles within calendar year x weekday; preserve exact annual weekday direction totals, break local serial order
weekly_rotation: Independent whole-week cyclic offsets within each calendar year over complete valid nonflat Monday-Sunday weeks; partial/invalid/flat-containing weeks fixed. Preserves weekday/year totals and most serial links; not a single global relabel of sixty labels
simulation_pipeline: Keep each Ganzhi actual sample counts and stage boundaries; reselect training direction, thresholds and top-k in every trial
correlations: Positive-tail Pearson and Spearman raw up-rate train/test, frozen majority Pearson, train55 selected Pearson; selection redone every trial
uncertainty: Empirical p=(exceed+1)/(B+1), Wilson 95% MC interval on exceed/B, finite MC resolution disclosed; no p=0 claim
multiplicity: Predefined families in core.py: full individual240, train/test individual480, conditional individual360; primary exact aggregate68; secondary exact remainder; MC primary200; MC other endpoints separately. Holm primary, BH secondary diagnostic; dependence allowed and never multiply evidence from overlapping tests
limits: These historical dates and named candidates were previously examined; retrospective statistical audit, not untouched prospective evidence or a trading-value test
